metadata.title: An odd-period pedal-antipedal area invariant in elliptic billiards
metadata.description: We prove the k403,a observation of Reznik, Garcia and Koiller: the signed area product of the original orbit's origin pedal and origin antipedal is phase independent for every primitive least odd period in a noncircular elliptic billiard with a strict confocal elliptical caustic. All admitted coprime stars are included and every real antipedal intersection is finite. The construction-specific proof distinguishes coincident and opposite complex endpoints, cancels incident double poles and identifies the odd-period quotient lattice. The earlier credited origin-pedal trace supplies the complementary factor. A direct circular extension and an exact same-caustic four-periodic counterexample delimit the theorem. The verification archive contains the standalone LaTeX source, exact algebra and reflected-orbit certificates, independent high-precision geometry and near-pole diagnostics, full receipt comparisons, source hashes, mathematical audits and bounded priority reports. The original observation, prior campaign pedal argument and classical elliptic/cyclic-identity methods are credited. No historical-firstness certificate is claimed. AI tools were used extensively in solving, verification, literature research, coding, writing and internal adversarial review. This is an unrefereed preprint without external human peer review or proof-assistant formalization.
